events.title: 35th Annual Cayucos Car Show
events.summary: Classic cars fill Ocean Ave all day; live band, beer garden, Lions BBQ, awards at 4pm. Rain or shine. Register via 805Tix.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos — Tree Lighting
events.venue: Corner of D Street & Ocean Ave, Cayucos
events.organizer: Cayucos Chamber of Commerce / Cayucos Rotary
events.summary: Free outdoor tree-lighting with live music, carolers, Santa & Mrs. Claus arriving by fire engine, kids' crafts & snow play area.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos — Wonderland Walk
events.organizer: Cayucos Chamber of Commerce / Cayucos Rotary
events.summary: Holiday stroll along Ocean Ave with open shops, Santa visits, Lioness Club refreshments, trolley & carriage rides. Free admission.

events.title: Schooners Open Mic Night
events.summary: Free weekly open mic in Schooners' Music Room hosted by Sam Fischer; sign-ups at 6pm, music starts 7pm. First Wed hosted by Kam Alton.
